description: This file defines two asynchronous functions, getUserCosts and getUserProjectsCosts, which perform complex MongoDB aggregation queries on a 'llmCosts' collection to compute user-specific cost summaries, including breakdowns by agent and type, as well as project-level costs with agent subtotals. It exports these functions for use in other parts of the application.

methods.name: getUserCosts
methods.description: Aggregates total cost for a user from the llm_costs collection, providing breakdowns by agent and type, normalizing alias fields, and handling null or missing values.

methods.name: getUserProjectsCosts
methods.description: Aggregates costs for a user grouped by project, with nested agent cost breakdowns, normalizing alias fields, and filtering out null or missing project IDs.
